items.title: 川普放行俄柴油自打臉！才簽制裁法就鬆綁 智庫反問：美國要關稅制裁自己？
items.title_en: Trump Lets Russian Diesel Slip, Undermining His Own Sanctions; Think Tank Asks: Should the U.S. Impose Tariffs on Itself?
paras: 美國總統川普周五(9日)宣布與俄羅斯達成柴油協議，由俄國分批供應480萬桶給美國，財政部也暫時解除禁令，顯示美國透過限制俄羅斯能源出口、施壓莫斯科結束烏克蘭戰爭的政策的方針似乎有所扭轉。
目前距離美國期中選舉不到一個月的時間，美國柴油價格正處於歷史高檔，川普宣稱，這項協議將迅速壓低柴油價格，協助民眾因應生活成本壓力。
批評者很快指出，新政策與美國打擊俄羅斯石油銷售的措施相互矛盾。川普三周前才簽署《Lindsey O. Graham 2026年制裁俄羅斯與伊朗法案》，對俄羅斯原油或天然氣的主要買家加徵最高100%的關稅，並採取其他限制措施。
自由意志派智庫卡托研究所(Cato Institute)副所長Scott Lincicome在X發文說：「國會才剛通過一項法律，授權川普對俄羅斯石油與天然氣的主要買家加徵新關稅。」
他還打趣說：「美國能對美國自己加徵關稅嗎？」
康乃狄克州民主黨聯邦參議員Richard Blumenthal也是參議院烏克蘭黨團成員。他批評，川普最新決定「直接違背國會在兩黨共同支持的制裁法案中所表達的意旨」。

共和黨質疑制裁法案效果

喬治城大學法學中心國際經濟法研究所訪問學者Peter Harrell在X發文表示，放寬俄羅斯柴油限制，「幾乎證明了《Graham對俄制裁法案》無法迫使川普政府擴大施壓莫斯科經濟」的說法。
共和黨議員也有意見，德州眾議員Michael McFaul在X發文表示：「透過《Lindsey O. Graham制裁俄羅斯與伊朗法案》，我們賦予總統重要權限與籌碼，可以對中國和俄羅斯施壓，促使普丁透過談判達成協議，結束戰爭。」
他接著說：「遺憾的是，儘管我理解希望降低柴油價格的用意，但我擔心解除對俄羅斯石油的制裁，只會資助克里姆林宮的戰爭機器，助長更多暴力與破壞。過去幾天發生的事情已經顯示這項風險。」
不到一年前，川普政府才以俄羅斯「未認真承諾透過和平進程結束烏克蘭戰爭」為由，制裁多家俄羅斯石油公司。
川普過去也曾抨擊北約盟國持續購買俄羅斯石油。他去年9月曾在Truth Social發文說：「某些國家購買俄羅斯石油的行為令人震驚！這大幅削弱了你們對俄羅斯的談判立場與籌碼。」
川普也曾在聯合國大會演說中抨擊與俄羅斯做生意的國家，「他們正在資助一場對抗自己的戰爭。誰聽過這種事？他們不能繼續這樣做。他們一邊與俄羅斯交戰，一邊向俄羅斯購買石油和天然氣。」

最新措施被指只是權宜之計

川普政府過去也曾暫時放寬部分俄羅斯能源制裁，但範圍比周五宣布的措施更有限。今年稍早，伊朗戰爭爆發後，川普政府為穩定市場，曾核發期限30天的有限豁免，允許各國購買已在運輸途中的受制裁俄羅斯石油。
不過，部分人士認為，這次措施的影響更為重大。
賓州大學華頓商學院金融學榮譽教授Jeremy Siegel說：「看起來川普與魔鬼做了交易。這根本不是永久性的解決方案，只是一種短期的權宜之計。而為了俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭一事，現在卻縮減甚至取消對俄制裁，我認為這是非常不幸的後果。」
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump announced on Friday (the 9th) that the United States has reached a diesel deal with Russia, under which Russia will supply 4.8 million barrels to the U.S. in batches, and the Treasury Department has temporarily lifted the ban, indicating a shift in the policy of pressuring Moscow by restricting Russian energy exports to end the war in Ukraine.

With less than a month left before the U.S. midterm elections, diesel prices are at historic highs, and Trump claims the agreement will quickly drive down diesel prices and help Americans cope with the cost‑of‑living squeeze.

Critics were quick to point out that the new policy contradicts the measures aimed at curbing Russian oil sales. Trump signed the Lindsey O. Graham 2026 Russia and Iran Sanctions Act just three weeks ago, which imposes up to a 100 % tariff on major buyers of Russian crude or natural gas and adds other restrictions.
Scott Lincicome, vice‑president of the libertarian Cato Institute, wrote on X that “Congress has just passed a law authorizing Trump to levy new tariffs on Russia’s major oil and gas buyers.”
He added wryly, “Can the United States impose tariffs on itself?”

Democratic Senator Richard Blumenthal of Connecticut, also a member of the Senate Ukraine caucus, criticized Trump’s latest move as “directly contrary to the intent expressed by Congress in the bipartisan sanctions bill.”

Republican‑leaning scholars also weighed in. Peter Harrell, a visiting scholar at Georgetown University Law Center’s International Economic Law Institute, posted on X that easing the Russian diesel restriction “almost proves that the Graham sanctions bill cannot force the Trump administration to increase pressure on Moscow’s economy.”

Republican Representative Michael McFaul of Texas wrote on X that “through the Lindsey O. Graham Russia and Iran Sanctions Act we gave the President important authority and leverage to pressure China and Russia, urging Putin to negotiate an agreement and end the war.”

He continued, “Regrettably, while I understand the desire to lower diesel prices, I fear that lifting sanctions on Russian oil will only fund the Kremlin’s war machine and fuel more violence and destruction. Recent events have already shown that risk.”
Less than a year ago, the Trump administration sanctioned several Russian oil firms on the grounds that Russia had not seriously committed to ending the Ukraine war through a peace process.

Trump has also previously attacked NATO allies for continuing to buy Russian oil. In September last year he posted on Truth Social, “The fact that some countries are buying Russian oil is shocking! It severely weakens your negotiating position and leverage with Russia.”

He also denounced countries doing business with Russia in a speech to the United Nations General Assembly, saying, “They are financing a war against themselves. Who has ever heard of that? They cannot keep doing this. They are fighting Russia on one hand while buying its oil and gas on the other.”

The latest move is being called a stop‑gap. The Trump administration has previously eased some Russian energy sanctions on a temporary basis, but those measures were far more limited than Friday’s announcement. Earlier this year, after the outbreak of the Iran war, the administration issued a 30‑day limited exemption to stabilize markets, allowing countries to purchase Russian oil already in transit that was under sanctions.
However, some observers say this time the impact is far more significant.

Jeremy Siegel, a distinguished professor of finance at the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania, said, “It looks like Trump made a deal with the devil. This is not a permanent solution at all, just a short‑term stop‑gap. And to reduce or even cancel sanctions on Russia for its invasion of Ukraine is, in my view, a very unfortunate outcome.”

items.title: 居家產業走出二年來低谷 家具、家電Q4買氣續旺
items.title_en: Home Industry Emerges from Two-Year Low as Furniture and Appliances See Strong Q4 Demand
paras: 隨著預售屋交屋潮湧現，國內連鎖家具龍頭詩肯(6195-TW)最新指出，觀察到近期家具需求大增，帶動居家產業快速復甦，預料第四季傳統消費旺季將持續穩健成長。
詩肯前三季合併營收18.61億元，年增15.67%，詩肯指出，隨著預售案大量進入交屋期，自住族群與首購族的家具採購需求已開始回溫，是今年居家產業走出過去兩年的低谷的主因。
而在家庭結構改變下，台灣住宅普遍朝向小宅發展，消費者更偏好高收納、多功能、體積精簡且美型設計的家具，也使詩肯在家具市場更具競爭力。
詩肯認為，第四季進入傳統居家消費旺季，換屋、裝修及年末居家整理需求增加將帶動汰舊換新潮，家具市場消費動能可望維持到農曆年前。
截至9月底，詩肯全台門市為84店，仍將視市場需求與商圈條件持續尋找展店機會，同時強化既有店的業務動能。
集雅社則指出，因今年是經濟部住宅家電汰舊換新節能補助的最後一年，一級能效冷氣、冰箱每台可申請3000元補助，搭配貨物稅退稅最高2000元，合計最高可省5000元，隨著周年慶進入旺季，高階家電換機需求升溫。
paras_en: As the wave of pre‑sale home handovers rolls in, domestic furniture chain leader Shiken (6195‑TW) noted a recent surge in furniture demand, driving a rapid recovery in the home sector and forecasting steady growth through the traditional fourth‑quarter consumption peak.

Shiken reported combined revenue of NT$1.861 billion for the first three quarters, up 15.67% year‑on‑year, and said that as many pre‑sale projects enter the handover phase, furniture purchases by owner‑occupiers and first‑time buyers have begun to rebound, which is the main reason the home industry is emerging from a two‑year trough this year.

With household structures shifting, Taiwanese residences are increasingly compact, leading consumers to favor furniture that offers high storage, multifunctionality, slim dimensions and stylish design, giving Shiken a competitive edge in the market.

Shiken believes that the fourth quarter marks the traditional home‑consumption peak, with increased demand for moving, renovation and year‑end home organization spurring a cycle of replacing old items, and expects the furniture market’s consumer momentum to continue through the Lunar New Year.

As of the end of September, Shiken operated 84 stores nationwide and will continue to seek expansion opportunities based on market demand and location conditions while strengthening the performance of existing outlets.

Jiya Society pointed out that this year is the final year for the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ subsidy program for replacing residential appliances with energy‑efficient models; first‑class efficient air conditioners and refrigerators qualify for a NT$3,000 subsidy per unit, plus up to NT$2,000 in goods‑tax rebates, for a total possible saving of NT$5,000, and with the anniversary sales season in full swing, demand for high‑end appliance upgrades is heating up.

items.title: 馬斯克身價不只破1兆美元！數據曝「差距不是一點點」 碾壓昔日石油與鋼鐵大王
items.title_en: Musk's Net Worth Tops $1 Trillion! Data Shows the Gap Is No Small Matter, Crushing Former Oil and Steel Tycoons
paras: 馬斯克不只是全球首位、也是目前唯一一位身價上兆美元的富豪，這不僅超越當代所有富豪，若以財富占當時美國國內生產毛額(GDP)的比重衡量，也超越洛克斐勒(John D. Rockefeller)等歷史上的工業巨頭。
MarketWatch報導，拜SpaceX(SPCX-US)與特斯拉(TSLA-US)股價近期上漲所賜，助馬斯克的財富最近重新回到1兆美元以上，彭博億萬富豪指數顯示截至周四(8日)的數字為1.02兆美元。
馬斯克的財富主要來自他持有的SpaceX與特斯拉股份，這兩家公司10月以來雙雙上漲6%，目前的市值分別為2.2兆美元和1.5兆美元。
根據8月提交給美國證券交易委員會(SEC)的文件，馬斯克持有SpaceX的48.4%股權，相當於約64.2億股普通股、選擇權及尚未歸屬的績效獎勵。另據6月提交的SEC文件，他也持有特斯拉20%的股權。
馬斯克還持有私人企業Neuralink與The Boring Co.的股份，但財富估算通常不會計入尚未歸屬的績效股票價值。
這些持股也使馬斯克的身家高度波動。他的財富在6月SpaceX上市後曾攀升至1.32兆美元，隨後因SpaceX股價回落，8月一度跌破7000億美元。

比全球第二至第四大富豪加總還多

儘管財富大幅波動，馬斯克仍穩居全球首富。他目前的身家甚至超過全球排名第二至第四的三位富豪總和，分別是Google(GOOGL-US)共同創辦人佩吉(Larry Page)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)創辦人貝佐斯(Jeff Bezos)，以及Google共同創辦人布林(Sergey Brin)。
馬斯克在2021年首度超越貝佐斯，成為全球最富有的人，而這五年來的大部分時間裡，馬斯克都穩坐全球首富寶座。
馬斯克身為兆美元富豪，背後反映著近年全球財富規模的上限不斷擴大。貝佐斯2020年成為史上首位身家突破2000億美元的人，而馬斯克在2025年4月，以3420億美元身家成為全球首富。在那之後的18個月裡，他的財富幾乎增至原本的三倍。

超越昔日石油和鋼鐵大王

馬斯克不僅是當今全球首富，若以財富占美國經濟規模的比重衡量，他也超越美國歷史上的其他富豪。
MarketWatch參考《富比士》(Forbes)2007年公布的美國史上最富有人士名單，選取可比較的歷史人物，再計算他們身價高峰時占當時美國GDP的比重，與現今的數字相比。
以美國第2季GDP得出的32.56兆美元年化數字計算，馬斯克財富相當於美國GDP約3.1%，高於此前任何一位美國富豪。
歷史上，19世紀與20世紀的富豪主要靠石油、鋼鐵與鐵路等新興市場累積財富。如今，人工智慧(AI)熱潮帶來的變革潛力，則常被拿來與工業革命相提並論，儘管AI對經濟的全面影響尚未完全顯現，馬斯克的財富占國內經濟產值的比重，卻已超越美國歷史上的其他富豪。
不過，以現代標準衡量過往財富並不容易，因為不同時期的經濟環境差異甚大，歷史身家估算也常因資料紀錄與估值方法不同而存在爭議。經濟學家通常會以財富占GDP的比重衡量歷史財富，而非單純依據一般消費者物價通膨進行調整。
例如，標準石油(Standard Oil)創辦人洛克斐勒長期被視為美國史上最富有的人。傳記作家Ron Chernow估計，洛克斐勒在1913年身家高峰時達9億美元，若按通膨調整，相當於今日的304億美元。
然而，若與當時美國GDP相比，1913年美國GDP為395億美元，洛克斐勒的財富占比為2.3%，相當於今日約7420億美元。
另一位知名富豪卡內基(Andrew Carnegie)據信一生捐出3.5億美元，約占其財富的90%。MarketWatch以1901年將Carnegie Steel出售給摩根大通(JP Morgan)作為基準，推測卡內基最高身價，這筆出售所得相當於當時美國GDP的1.1%，折合今日約3550億美元。
paras_en: Musk is not only the world’s first, and currently the only, billionaire with a net worth exceeding one trillion dollars; this surpasses all contemporary billionaires and, when measured as a share of the U.S. gross domestic product at the time, also exceeds historic industrial giants such as John D. Rockefeller.

According to MarketWatch, recent gains in SpaceX (SPCX-US) and Tesla (TSLA-US) stock prices have pushed Musk’s wealth back above the $1‑trillion mark, with Bloomberg’s Billionaires Index showing a figure of $1.02 trillion as of Thursday the 8th.

Musk’s wealth comes mainly from his stakes in SpaceX and Tesla, both of which have risen about 6% since October, giving the companies market capitalisations of roughly $2.2 trillion and $1.5 trillion respectively.

SEC filings submitted in August show Musk holds 48.4% of SpaceX, equivalent to about 6.42 billion shares of common stock, options and unvested performance awards. A June filing indicates he also owns about 20% of Tesla.
Musk also owns shares in private ventures Neuralink and The Boring Company, but wealth estimates typically do not count the value of unvested performance stock from those firms.

These holdings make Musk’s net worth highly volatile. After SpaceX’s June IPO his wealth peaked at $1.32 trillion, then fell as the SpaceX share price retreated, briefly dropping below $700 billion in August.

Despite the swings, Musk remains the world’s richest person. His current fortune even exceeds the combined wealth of the world’s #2‑#4 richest individuals – Google co‑founder Larry Page, Amazon founder Jeff Bezos and Google co‑founder Sergey Brin.
Musk first overtook Bezos in 2021 to become the world’s richest person, and for most of the past five years he has held the top spot.

Musk’s status as a trillion‑dollar billionaire reflects the expanding ceiling of global wealth. Bezos became the first person to break the $200 billion barrier in 2020, and Musk reached $342 billion in April 2025 to claim the top spot. In the following 18 months his wealth nearly tripled its prior level.
Beyond being today’s richest person, Musk also surpasses historic U.S. magnates when his wealth is measured as a share of the American economy.

MarketWatch referenced Forbes’ 2007 list of the richest Americans, selected comparable historical figures, and calculated the share of U.S. GDP their peak fortunes represented, then compared those ratios to today’s numbers.
Using the annualized Q2 U.S. GDP figure of $32.56 trillion, Musk’s wealth equates to about 3.1% of U.S. GDP – higher than any previous American billionaire.

Historically, 19th‑ and early‑20th‑century fortunes were built on oil, steel and railroads. Today the AI boom’s transformative potential is often likened to the Industrial Revolution; although AI’s full economic impact is still unfolding, Musk’s share of national output already exceeds that of past U.S. titans.

However, comparing modern wealth to historic fortunes is difficult because of vastly different economic contexts and divergent valuation methods, which can spark debate. Economists usually gauge historic wealth by its GDP share rather than simple inflation‑adjusted dollars.

For example, Standard Oil founder John D. Rockefeller has long been regarded as America’s richest person. Biographer Ron Chernow estimates Rockefeller’s 1913 peak net worth at $900 million, which inflation‑adjusted equals about $30.4 billion today.
But relative to 1913 U.S. GDP of $39.5 billion, Rockefeller’s wealth represented 2.3% of the economy – equivalent to roughly $7.42 trillion in today’s terms.

Another famed magnate, Andrew Carnegie, is believed to have donated $350 million – about 90% of his fortune – during his lifetime. MarketWatch uses Carnegie’s 1901 sale of Carnegie Steel to J.P. Morgan as a benchmark, estimating his peak wealth at about 1.1% of U.S. GDP then, or roughly $3.55 trillion in today’s dollars.

items.title: 全球低軌衛星部署加速 啓碁、耀登卡位地面設備與天線長線看俏
items.title_en: Global Low‑Earth‑Orbit Satellite Deployment Accelerates; Qisda and Yao‑Den Poised for Ground Equipment and Antenna Demand Surge
paras: 全球低軌衛星市場迎來新一波爆發期，隨著SpaceX星鏈計畫邁向新一代V3規模部署以及藍色起源等科技巨擘擴大太空布局，在地面終端設備與射頻天線領域耕耘已久的網通大廠啓碁(6285-TW)與射頻廠耀登(3138-TW)長線營運直接受惠。
根據研調機構TrendForce預估，在V3衛星部署、星艦降低發射成本以及6G非地面網路應用逐步成形帶動下，全球衛星火箭發射市場規模將由2026年的293億美元增至2028年的404億美元，兩年成長近40%，且受惠範圍正由零組件向模組與系統整合全面擴大。
在產業產值結構中，地面裝置製造占比高達54.58%，屬於產值最大且台廠最具競爭優勢的領域，而隨著Starlink訂閱用戶數持續攀升至1200萬戶，加上亞馬遜(AMZN-US)旗下藍色起源正規劃部署逾5萬顆衛星的軌道資料中心與TeraWave企業級衛星通訊，龐大的地面終端需求正加速釋出。
為深耕技術並降低射頻前端成本，啓碁日前更與工研院資通所展開合作，共同推動國產Ka頻段陣列天線模組量產，藉由採用台灣首款自主開發的波束成型晶片，加速地面接收端、無人機、車載等高移動性終端場域的商用化進程。
耀登則鎖定6G非地面網路與低軌衛星地面設備商機，除了取得國家太空中心Ka頻段地面接收站專案並與低軌及中高軌衛星客戶接洽外，在量測認證服務上也已將驗證能力延伸至衛星地面收發設備，提供客戶一站式整合服務。
在量測設備業務方面，耀登已導入加拿大與丹麥兩家關鍵衛星通訊模擬與天線測試設備代理，海外產能方面，兩家業者亦積極推進非紅供應鏈布局以去化長線訂單，啓碁擴建越南與墨西哥產能，並規劃2026年越南產能占比過半，耀登的越南新廠也預定第三季投產，未來產線更具備擴充至18條的潛力。
paras_en: The global low‑Earth‑orbit (LEO) satellite market is entering a new wave of explosive growth. With SpaceX’s Starlink moving to a next‑generation V3 large‑scale deployment and tech giants such as Blue Origin expanding their space footprint, network‑equipment giants that have long cultivated the ground‑terminal and RF‑antenna sectors—Qisda (6285‑TW) and RF firm Yao‑Den (3138‑TW)—are set to benefit directly from long‑term operations.

According to research firm TrendForce, the worldwide satellite‑rocket launch market is projected to expand from $29.3 billion in 2026 to $40.4 billion in 2028—a near‑40% increase over two years—driven by V3 satellite deployments, reduced launch costs from Starship, and the gradual emergence of 6G non‑terrestrial network applications. The beneficiary scope is widening from components to full‑module and system integration.

Within the industry value chain, ground‑device manufacturing accounts for a hefty 54.58% of total output, making it the largest segment and the one where Taiwanese firms hold the strongest competitive edge. As Starlink’s subscriber base climbs to 12 million and Amazon’s Blue Origin plans an orbital data‑center and TeraWave enterprise‑grade satellite communications network backed by more than 50,000 satellites, massive demand for ground terminals is being released at speed.

To deepen its technology and cut RF front‑end costs, Qisda recently partnered with the Institute for Information Industry’s Communications Research Institute to push mass production of a domestically‑made Ka‑band array‑antenna module. The effort leverages Taiwan’s first home‑grown beam‑forming chip to accelerate commercialization of high‑mobility terminals such as ground receivers, drones and vehicle‑mounted units.

Yao‑Den is targeting the 6G non‑terrestrial network and LEO ground‑equipment market. In addition to securing a Ka‑band ground‑station project from the National Space Center and engaging with LEO and medium‑high‑orbit satellite customers, the company has extended its measurement‑certification capabilities to satellite ground‑transceiver equipment, offering customers a one‑stop integrated service.

In its measurement‑equipment business, Yao‑Den has incorporated two key satellite‑communication simulation and antenna‑testing equipment agents from Canada and Denmark. Regarding overseas capacity, both partners are actively advancing non‑red‑supply‑chain layouts to absorb long‑term orders. Qisda is expanding capacity in Vietnam and Mexico, aiming for Vietnam to account for over half of its output by 2026, while Yao‑Den’s new Vietnam plant is slated to start production in Q3, with the line designed for future expansion to up to 18 lines.

items.title: 每2人就有1個E人！貝萊德調查：台灣ETF滲透率53%穩居亞太第一
items.title_en: One in Two People Own an ETF! BlackRock Survey Shows Taiwan’s ETF Penetration at 53%, Highest in Asia‑Pacific
paras: 全球最大ETF品牌貝萊德iShares發布最新《2026亞太ETF投資人洞察》報告，揭露台灣成年人持有ETF的滲透率高達53%，高居亞太五大市場之冠。相較於香港的31%、新加坡的18.7%、澳洲的16%及日本的3%，台灣市場展現極高的普及度與成熟度。在產品偏好上，台灣投資人除了擁抱股票型（55%）與高股息型（52%）外，對「主動型ETF」的偏好度更達40%，顯著超越澳洲與香港，成為亞太區主動型商品需求最旺盛的市場。貝萊德投信表示，ETF在台灣已從單純投資工具轉化為全民理財基礎，未來成長動能將來自配置觀念的持續進化。
當ETF從單純的投資工具演變為全民理財語言，台灣正以驚人的普及速度站上亞太市場的領先地位。全球最大ETF品牌貝萊德iShares最新發布《2026亞太ETF投資人洞察》報告，揭露亞太五大市場的最新投資面貌。調查顯示，台灣成年人持有ETF的滲透率高達53%，不僅榮登亞太五大市場龍頭，普及率更遠超日本的3%近18倍，展現顯著的區域成熟度落差。
針對本次宏觀調查結果，貝萊德投信董事總經理陳正芳表示，這項橫跨台灣、澳洲、日本、新加坡及香港的調查顯示，亞太各地的ETF發展步調存在巨大懸殊。台灣成年人在ETF持有滲透率上拔得頭籌（53%），大幅領先第二名香港的31%、新加坡的18.7%與澳洲的16%，而日本市場則以3%居末，凸顯台灣在ETF市場的普及程度已成熟領跑全亞太。
在產品偏好層面，陳正芳分析，亞太區投資人對ETF展現出「核心配置共通、周邊需求在地化」的分歧特色。雖然股票型與收益型ETF是亞太各市場共同的核心投資基石，但走出核心資產之外，各市場的投資偏好則展現出鮮明的在地色彩。
陳正芳進一步說明，台灣投資人除了高度青睞股票型（55%）與高股息／收益型ETF（52%）外，對「主動型ETF」的偏好更在亞太市場中異軍突起，持有比例高達40%。這一數據顯著超越澳洲的25%與香港的24%，讓台灣一舉成為亞太區主動型商品需求最旺盛的市場。
對比亞太其他地區，各國投資人的偏好呈現多元發展。澳洲投資人高度偏好數位資產（加密貨幣）ETF，比例高達40%，僅次於股票型的58%；香港投資人除了以股票型（75%）為大宗外，偏好則廣泛分散於債券型（47%）、商品型（39%）與貨幣型ETF（37%）。
陳正芳強調，調查結果充分反映台灣在ETF普及率與產品接受度上均已躍居亞太領頭羊，投資人不僅將ETF視為核心資產配置工具，對主動型等新型態ETF也展現出成熟且開放的配置意願。ETF在台灣已從單純的投資工具，逐步發展為大眾理財與長期資產配置的重要基礎，未來市場成長動能將不僅來自投資人數增加，更來自投資需求的持續進化與配置觀念的成熟。
paras_en: BlackRock’s iShares, the world’s largest ETF brand, released its latest “2026 Asia‑Pacific ETF Investor Insights” report, revealing that 53% of Taiwanese adults hold ETFs, the highest penetration among the five major Asia‑Pacific markets. Compared with Hong Kong’s 31%, Singapore’s 18.7%, Australia’s 16% and Japan’s 3%, Taiwan demonstrates a very high level of adoption and market maturity. In terms of product preference, Taiwanese investors not only embrace equity‑type (55%) and high‑dividend (52%) ETFs, but also show a 40% preference for “active ETFs,” markedly surpassing Australia and Hong Kong and making Taiwan the strongest demand market for active products in the region. BlackRock Investment Management says ETFs in Taiwan have shifted from a simple investment tool to a foundation of personal finance for the whole population, with future growth driven by the continued evolution of allocation concepts.

As ETFs evolve from a pure investment tool into a language of personal finance for the masses, Taiwan is rapidly taking the lead in the Asia‑Pacific market. BlackRock’s iShares has just published its “2026 Asia‑Pacific ETF Investor Insights” report, unveiling the latest investment landscape across the five largest markets in the region. The survey shows that 53% of Taiwanese adults hold ETFs, not only topping the Asia‑Pacific list but also exceeding Japan’s 3% by nearly eighteen‑fold, highlighting a striking regional maturity gap.

Commenting on the macro‑survey results, Chen Zheng‑fang, Managing Director of BlackRock Investment Management, said the cross‑country study covering Taiwan, Australia, Japan, Singapore and Hong Kong shows a huge disparity in ETF development across Asia‑Pacific. Taiwanese adults lead with a 53% ETF‑holding penetration, far ahead of second‑place Hong Kong at 31%, Singapore at 18.7% and Australia at 16%, while Japan trails at 3%, underscoring Taiwan’s mature and leading position in the regional ETF market.

On product preference, Chen explained that investors across Asia‑Pacific exhibit a “core allocation commonality with localized peripheral demand.” While equity‑type and income‑type ETFs form the core investment foundation in all markets, preferences beyond these core assets display distinct local characteristics.

Chen added that Taiwanese investors not only strongly favor equity‑type (55%) and high‑dividend/income ETFs (52%), but also stand out in the region for their preference for “active ETFs,” with a holding rate of 40%. This figure far exceeds Australia’s 25% and Hong Kong’s 24%, making Taiwan the market with the most vigorous demand for active products in Asia‑Pacific.

Compared with other Asia‑Pacific regions, investors’ preferences are diverse. Australian investors show a high appetite for digital‑asset (cryptocurrency) ETFs, at 40%, second only to equity‑type ETFs at 58%. Hong Kong investors, besides a dominant 75% preference for equity‑type ETFs, spread their interest across bond ETFs (47%), commodity ETFs (39%) and currency ETFs (37%).

Chen emphasized that the survey results clearly show Taiwan has become the Asia‑Pacific leader in both ETF penetration and product acceptance. Investors view ETFs not only as core asset‑allocation tools but also demonstrate a mature and open willingness to allocate to newer formats such as active ETFs. In Taiwan, ETFs have progressed from a simple investment instrument to a fundamental component of mass‑market financial planning and long‑term asset allocation, with future market growth driven not only by a larger investor base but also by the ongoing evolution of investment demand and sophisticated allocation mindsets.

items.title: 嘉威9月營收再現年成長達44% 前9月營收下滑幅度進一步收歛
items.title_en: Jiawei September Revenue Shows 44% Year‑over‑Year Growth as Nine‑Month Decline Further Narrows
paras: 嘉威生活(3557-TW)迎接旺季來臨前的需求再進一步升溫，嘉威9月營收達2.98億元，月增14.02%，年增44.56%；累計2026年前9月營收31.65億元，年減幅由前8月的8.85%進一步收斂至5.57%，營運回升趨勢更加明確；同時，嘉威生活第四季將迎接歐美的採購需求超級旺季。
嘉威生活的累計營收下滑幅度收歛，主要在第三季營收達7.7億元，年增幅21.18%；回升趨勢明確。 展望第四季，嘉威生活隨著美國零售市場正式進入Holiday傳統消費旺季，各主要客戶的節慶商品及Everyday商品持續出貨，公司預期第四季拉貨動能可望延續。
而嘉威生活前三季累計營收年減幅已由前8月的8.85%快速收斂至5.57%，加上FDG及Prepara持續貢獻，嘉威預期第四季可望進一步縮小與去年同期的累計營收差距，持續改善全年營運表現。
嘉威主管指出，雖然9月美國客戶已提前啟動第四季旺季拉貨模式，各主要零售通路的Holiday節慶商品全面進入出貨期，加上長期穩定的Everyday常態性商品訂單，兩大產品線合計已占公司約一半出貨量，成為9月營收大幅成長的重要動能，也反映美國市場拉貨力道持續升溫。
除大型零售通路外，嘉威長期深耕Pottery Barn、Crate & Barrel及Williams-Sonoma等中高階居家生活客戶，相關高附加價值產品維持穩定出貨，持續支持嘉威的獲利品質，形成大型零售客戶帶動營收規模、中高階客戶兼顧獲利的多元客戶組合。
海外布局方面，嘉威美國子公司FDG 9月持續貢獻營收，出貨櫃量占中國整體出貨櫃量逾10%；旗下廚具品牌Prepara則持續開發新品，加速全球銷售及通路布局，目前產品已銷往美國、歐洲、日本及韓國。公司並在美國及歐洲當地設立倉庫，透過就近供應優勢提升出貨效率，顯示除嘉威本體外，美國子公司及品牌業務也逐步挹注集團營運表現。
嘉威生活2026年上半年營收 23.95 億元，年減 11.8%，主要受到第一季營收下滑影響，不過，隨著第二季營運逐步回升，上半年毛利率仍達 35.52%，較去年同期提升 0.27 百分點；稅後純益 5704 萬元，每股純益 0.68 元。
paras_en: Jiawei Living (3557‑TW) saw demand heat up ahead of the peak season, with September revenue reaching NT$298 million, up 14.02% month‑over‑month and 44.56% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first nine months of 2026 was NT$3.165 billion, with the year‑over‑year decline narrowing from an 8.85% drop in the first eight months to 5.57%, indicating a clearer operational recovery. The company also expects a super‑strong procurement season in Europe and the United States in Q4.

The contraction in cumulative revenue was driven by a strong third‑quarter performance of NT$770 million, a 21.18% year‑over‑year increase, underscoring the rebound trend. Looking ahead to Q4, Jiawei Living anticipates continued momentum as the U.S. retail market enters the traditional holiday shopping season, with major customers shipping festive and everyday items, which should sustain the pull‑forward effect.

The year‑over‑year decline in cumulative revenue for the first three quarters has quickly narrowed from 8.85% after eight months to 5.57% after nine months. Combined with ongoing contributions from FDG and the Prepara brand, Jiawei expects the gap with the same period last year to shrink further in Q4, further improving full‑year performance.

Management noted that, although U.S. customers began pulling forward fourth‑quarter inventory in September, holiday merchandise across major retail channels entered the shipping phase, and stable everyday product orders persisted. The two product lines now account for roughly half of the company's shipments, driving the strong September revenue growth and reflecting continued acceleration of pull‑forward activity in the U.S. market.

Beyond large retail chains, Jiawei has long cultivated mid‑to‑high‑end home‑lifestyle customers such as Pottery Barn, Crate & Barrel and Williams‑Sonoma. High‑margin products for these accounts remain steady, supporting profit quality and creating a diversified customer mix that balances scale from big retailers with profitability from premium clients.

On the overseas front, Jiawei’s U.S. subsidiary FDG continued to contribute in September, with its container shipments representing more than 10% of the group's total containers shipped from China. Its kitchenware brand Prepara kept launching new products, accelerating global sales and channel expansion, with offerings now in the United States, Europe, Japan and South Korea. The company has also set up warehouses in the U.S. and Europe to improve delivery efficiency, showing that the U.S. subsidiary and brand businesses are increasingly bolstering the group’s overall performance.

Jiawei Living posted first‑half‑2026 revenue of NT$2.395 billion, an 11.8% year‑over‑year decline, mainly due to weaker first‑quarter sales. However, as operations recovered in the second quarter, the half‑year gross margin remained at 35.52%, up 0.27 percentage points from a year earlier. Net profit after tax was NT$57.04 million, or NT$0.68 per share.

items.title: 縫紉機出貨旺季！伸興9月營收創今年單月最佳 全年營運成長可期
items.title_en: Sewing‑Machine Shipping Peak Season! Shenxing’s September Revenue Sets a New Monthly High for 2026, Full‑Year Operational Growth Expected
paras: 伸興(1558-TW)公告2026年9月合併營收達 9.68 億元，月增8.81%，年增29.19%，創今年單月營收新高；2026年第三季合併營收達27.95億元，季增21.95%，年增24.31%；累計前9月合併營收70.13億元，年增8.35%。受惠於主要客戶拉貨動能增溫與產業旺季效益，良好的訂單成長基礎，有助於今年整體營運保持良好的正向成長動能。
伸興表示，每年第二至第三季是家用縫紉機產業的傳統出貨旺季，主要受惠於歐美市場聖誕節、感恩節等節慶購物季前夕的通路補貨需求。隨著終端零售通路庫存健康度持續回升，各大國際縫紉機品牌客戶積極備貨，推升公司9月家用縫紉機出貨量大幅提升。
除傳統季節性旺季效益發酵外，近年來全球手作DIY文化、客製化服飾與個人化手作紡織品的流行趨勢熱度不減，進一步帶動中高階家用縫紉機與多功能電縫機的穩定需求。伸興憑藉優異的研發製造能力，成功協助客戶推出具備智慧化與便利操作功能的機種，有效掌握市場趨勢，進一步挹注整體營運成長動能，助力整體訂單保持良好的能見度。
面對全球供應鏈重組與市場快速變化的挑戰，伸興持續精進台灣、中國、東南亞地區的產能佈局與精實生產，並發揮靈活調度優勢，不僅有效維持優異的生產效率與產品良率，亦能迅速響應品牌客戶的急單與彈性拉貨需求，發揮強大的供應鏈管理韌性。
展望2026年第四季，伸興對整體營運發展保持審慎態度。隨著第四季持續迎來傳統多元產業需求，加上縫紉機在中高階機種出貨比重提升與全球產能彈性調度的優勢，公司有信心推升下半年營運效益，帶動2026全年整體營運規模與績效繳出良好的成績單。
paras_en: Shenxing (1558‑TW) announced that its consolidated revenue for September 2026 reached NT$968 million, up 8.81% month‑over‑month and 29.19% year‑over‑year, marking the highest monthly revenue this year; the third‑quarter consolidated revenue was NT$2.795 billion, up 21.95% quarter‑over‑quarter and 24.31% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first nine months totaled NT$7.013 billion, an 8.35% increase year‑over‑year. Benefiting from stronger pull‑forward orders from major customers and seasonal industry effects, the solid order‑growth foundation helps maintain a positive growth momentum for the year’s overall operations.

Shenxing noted that the second to third quarters are the traditional shipping peak season for the household sewing‑machine industry, mainly driven by replenishment demand ahead of holiday shopping seasons such as Christmas and Thanksgiving in Europe and the United States. As inventory health in end‑retail channels continues to improve, major international sewing‑machine brands are actively stocking up, boosting the company’s household sewing‑machine shipments sharply in September.

Beyond the usual seasonal boost, the recent global DIY craft culture, customized apparel, and personalized textile trends have kept demand for mid‑to‑high‑end household sewing machines and multifunctional electric sewing machines strong. Leveraging its superior R&D and manufacturing capabilities, Shenxing has helped customers launch models with smart and user‑friendly features, effectively capturing market trends and injecting further growth momentum into overall operations, supporting a healthy order outlook.

Facing the challenges of global supply‑chain restructuring and rapid market changes, Shenxing continues to refine its capacity layout and lean production in Taiwan, China and Southeast Asia, and to exploit flexible scheduling advantages. This not only sustains high production efficiency and product yield, but also enables rapid response to urgent orders and flexible pull‑forward requests from brand customers, demonstrating strong supply‑chain resilience.

Looking ahead to the fourth quarter of 2026, Shenxing maintains a cautious stance on overall operational development. With the quarter expected to bring continued diversified industry demand, an increasing share of mid‑to‑high‑end sewing‑machine shipments, and the advantage of flexible global capacity scheduling, the company is confident it can lift second‑half performance and deliver a solid full‑year operational scale and results.

items.title: AI成長利多齊發 美銀調升Marvell目標價
items.title_en: AI Growth Catalysts Align as BofA Raises Marvell Target Price
paras: 《TheStreet》報導，邁威爾科技(Marvell Technology)(MRVL-US)股東近期收到美國銀行釋出的強烈利多訊號。在這家晶片製造商舉行分析師日(Analyst Day)後，美銀大幅調升目標價，並上修多項關鍵財務預測。Marvell管理層也在活動中描繪出更具企圖心的長期成長藍圖。
活動結束後，美銀認為，Marvell涵蓋網路、光學、儲存及客製化運算的產品組合，可以讓公司在AI基礎設施建置浪潮中扮演更重要的角色，而市場目前尚未充分反映這項潛力。
從投資績效來看，Marvell股票一直是為投資人創造可觀長期報酬標的，相較之下，整體AI概念股走勢則更加震盪。根據Seeking Alpha，Marvell今年以來上漲235%，遠高於標普500指數14%的漲幅。
美銀分析師在研究報告中指出，這場活動進一步鞏固了他們對Marvell的看多觀點。隨著大型雲端服務業者(hyperscaler)持續增加對客製化晶片與高速互連技術的支出，Marvell有能力讓成長速度超越其終端市場。
不過，尚待解答的問題是，Marvell能否將更廣泛的市場機會，轉化為持續性的獲利成長，並實現美銀最新財測所反映的成長預期。
Marvell於10月6日舉行的投資人日活動，大幅提高了外界對公司長期發展規模的期待，也促使美銀及其他銀行調升目標價與財務預測。

管理層將2028會計年度營收展望上調至約200億美元，並提出2031會計年度營收目標700億至900億美元，中間值為800億美元。
Marvell目前估計，到2030年，其潛在市場規模(TAM)將達約4,000億美元，約為先前估計的4倍。
執行長Matt Murphy強調，「所有這些預測，都建立在我們目前的業務、客戶布局，以及眼前已經存在的機會之上。」


在Marvell分析師日結束後，美銀維持買進評級，目標價為400美元，同時大幅調升長期獲利展望。以報告採用的參考股價271.25美元計算，意味著約47.5%上漲空間。
同時，美銀將Marvell 2028會計年度營收預估從180.1億美元上調至200.9億美元，並將2029會計年度營收預估從285億美元提高至348.4億美元。
每股盈餘(EPS)方面，美銀將2028會計年度預估從6.60美元上調至7.59美元，2029會計年度預估則從11.02美元提高至13.92美元。
美銀也看好Google TPU生態系帶來的額外成長機會。
Marvell的XPU搭載商機，可能受惠於Google TPU出貨量成長，以及其他大型雲端服務業者更廣泛採用相關技術。針對Google的機會，美銀估計，這家科技巨頭在2028年的TPU出貨量可能達1,200萬至1,300萬顆，到2030年則可能增至1,500萬至2,000萬顆以上，為Marvell創造可觀的搭載商機。
美銀也預期，隨著時間推進，Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)帶來的XPU搭載相關銷售額，占Marvell此類業務的比重將低於一半。
此外，美銀也將亞馬遜(AMZN-US)的AWS Trainium，以及微軟(MSFT-US)的Maia，視為未來值得關注的重要成長動能。
paras_en: TheStreet reports that shareholders of Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) have recently received strong bullish signals from Bank of America. After the chipmaker’s Analyst Day, BofA sharply raised its price target and upgraded several key financial forecasts. Marvell’s management also outlined a more ambitious long‑term growth roadmap during the event.

Following the event, BofA believes Marvell’s product portfolio spanning networking, optics, storage and custom compute positions the company to play a larger role in the wave of AI infrastructure build‑out, a potential the market has not yet fully priced in.

From an investment performance perspective, Marvell’s stock has consistently delivered solid long‑term returns for investors, whereas the broader AI concept stocks have been more volatile. According to Seeking Alpha, Marvell is up 235% year‑to‑date, far outpacing the S&P 500’s 14% gain.

BofA analysts noted in their research report that the event further cemented their bullish view on Marvell. As hyperscalers continue to increase spending on custom chips and high‑speed interconnect technologies, Marvell is well‑positioned to grow faster than its end‑market demand.

However, an unanswered question remains whether Marvell can convert the broader market opportunity into sustained profit growth and meet the growth expectations reflected in BofA’s latest financial outlook.

Marvell’s investor day on October 6 significantly raised external expectations for the company’s long‑term development scale and prompted BofA and other banks to lift price targets and financial forecasts.

Management lifted its FY2028 revenue outlook to roughly $20 billion and set a FY2031 revenue target of $70‑90 billion, with a midpoint of $80 billion. Marvell now estimates its total addressable market could reach about $400 billion by 2030, roughly four times its prior estimate. CEO Matt Murphy emphasized, “All these forecasts are built on our current business, customer footprint, and the opportunities already in front of us.” After Analyst Day, BofA maintained a buy rating with a $400 price target, representing about a 47.5% upside from the report’s reference price of $271.25.
At the same time, BofA raised its FY2028 revenue estimate from $18.01 billion to $20.09 billion and increased the FY2029 estimate from $28.5 billion to $34.84 billion.
Regarding earnings per share, BofA lifted its FY2028 EPS forecast from $6.60 to $7.59 and its FY2029 EPS projection from $11.02 to $13.92.
BofA also sees additional growth upside from Google’s TPU ecosystem.

Marvell’s XPU opportunities could benefit from growing Google TPU shipments and broader adoption of the technology by other large cloud providers. BofA estimates Google’s TPU shipments could reach 12‑13 million units in 2028 and rise to 15‑20 million units or more by 2030, creating a sizable addressable market for Marvell.
BofA expects that, over time, the sales of XPU‑related products tied to Alphabet (GOOGL-US) will account for less than half of Marvell’s revenue in that segment.
Additionally, BofA views Amazon’s AWS Trainium and Microsoft’s (MSFT-US) Maia as important growth engines to watch going forward.

items.title: 居家產業走出二年來低谷 家具、家電Q4買氣續旺
items.title_en: Home Industry Emerges from Two-Year Low as Furniture and Appliances See Strong Q4 Demand
paras: 隨著預售屋交屋潮湧現，國內連鎖家具龍頭詩肯(6195-TW)最新指出，觀察到近期家具需求大增，帶動居家產業快速復甦，預料第四季傳統消費旺季將持續穩健成長。
詩肯前三季合併營收18.61億元，年增15.67%，詩肯指出，隨著預售案大量進入交屋期，自住族群與首購族的家具採購需求已開始回溫，是今年居家產業走出過去兩年的低谷的主因。
而在家庭結構改變下，台灣住宅普遍朝向小宅發展，消費者更偏好高收納、多功能、體積精簡且美型設計的家具，也使詩肯在家具市場更具競爭力。
詩肯認為，第四季進入傳統居家消費旺季，換屋、裝修及年末居家整理需求增加將帶動汰舊換新潮，家具市場消費動能可望維持到農曆年前。
截至9月底，詩肯全台門市為84店，仍將視市場需求與商圈條件持續尋找展店機會，同時強化既有店的業務動能。
集雅社則指出，因今年是經濟部住宅家電汰舊換新節能補助的最後一年，一級能效冷氣、冰箱每台可申請3000元補助，搭配貨物稅退稅最高2000元，合計最高可省5000元，隨著周年慶進入旺季，高階家電換機需求升溫。
paras_en: As the wave of pre‑sale home handovers rolls in, domestic furniture chain leader Shiken (6195‑TW) noted a recent surge in furniture demand, driving a rapid recovery in the home sector and forecasting steady growth through the traditional fourth‑quarter consumption peak.

Shiken reported combined revenue of NT$1.861 billion for the first three quarters, up 15.67% year‑on‑year, and said that as many pre‑sale projects enter the handover phase, furniture purchases by owner‑occupiers and first‑time buyers have begun to rebound, which is the main reason the home industry is emerging from a two‑year trough this year.

With household structures shifting, Taiwanese residences are increasingly compact, leading consumers to favor furniture that offers high storage, multifunctionality, slim dimensions and stylish design, giving Shiken a competitive edge in the market.

Shiken believes that the fourth quarter marks the traditional home‑consumption peak, with increased demand for moving, renovation and year‑end home organization spurring a cycle of replacing old items, and expects the furniture market’s consumer momentum to continue through the Lunar New Year.

As of the end of September, Shiken operated 84 stores nationwide and will continue to seek expansion opportunities based on market demand and location conditions while strengthening the performance of existing outlets.

Jiya Society pointed out that this year is the final year for the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ subsidy program for replacing residential appliances with energy‑efficient models; first‑class efficient air conditioners and refrigerators qualify for a NT$3,000 subsidy per unit, plus up to NT$2,000 in goods‑tax rebates, for a total possible saving of NT$5,000, and with the anniversary sales season in full swing, demand for high‑end appliance upgrades is heating up.

items.title: 全球低軌衛星部署加速 啓碁、耀登卡位地面設備與天線長線看俏
items.title_en: Global Low‑Earth‑Orbit Satellite Deployment Accelerates; Qisda and Yao‑Den Poised for Ground Equipment and Antenna Demand Surge
paras: 全球低軌衛星市場迎來新一波爆發期，隨著SpaceX星鏈計畫邁向新一代V3規模部署以及藍色起源等科技巨擘擴大太空布局，在地面終端設備與射頻天線領域耕耘已久的網通大廠啓碁(6285-TW)與射頻廠耀登(3138-TW)長線營運直接受惠。
根據研調機構TrendForce預估，在V3衛星部署、星艦降低發射成本以及6G非地面網路應用逐步成形帶動下，全球衛星火箭發射市場規模將由2026年的293億美元增至2028年的404億美元，兩年成長近40%，且受惠範圍正由零組件向模組與系統整合全面擴大。
在產業產值結構中，地面裝置製造占比高達54.58%，屬於產值最大且台廠最具競爭優勢的領域，而隨著Starlink訂閱用戶數持續攀升至1200萬戶，加上亞馬遜(AMZN-US)旗下藍色起源正規劃部署逾5萬顆衛星的軌道資料中心與TeraWave企業級衛星通訊，龐大的地面終端需求正加速釋出。
為深耕技術並降低射頻前端成本，啓碁日前更與工研院資通所展開合作，共同推動國產Ka頻段陣列天線模組量產，藉由採用台灣首款自主開發的波束成型晶片，加速地面接收端、無人機、車載等高移動性終端場域的商用化進程。
耀登則鎖定6G非地面網路與低軌衛星地面設備商機，除了取得國家太空中心Ka頻段地面接收站專案並與低軌及中高軌衛星客戶接洽外，在量測認證服務上也已將驗證能力延伸至衛星地面收發設備，提供客戶一站式整合服務。
在量測設備業務方面，耀登已導入加拿大與丹麥兩家關鍵衛星通訊模擬與天線測試設備代理，海外產能方面，兩家業者亦積極推進非紅供應鏈布局以去化長線訂單，啓碁擴建越南與墨西哥產能，並規劃2026年越南產能占比過半，耀登的越南新廠也預定第三季投產，未來產線更具備擴充至18條的潛力。
paras_en: The global low‑Earth‑orbit (LEO) satellite market is entering a new wave of explosive growth. With SpaceX’s Starlink moving to a next‑generation V3 large‑scale deployment and tech giants such as Blue Origin expanding their space footprint, network‑equipment giants that have long cultivated the ground‑terminal and RF‑antenna sectors—Qisda (6285‑TW) and RF firm Yao‑Den (3138‑TW)—are set to benefit directly from long‑term operations.

According to research firm TrendForce, the worldwide satellite‑rocket launch market is projected to expand from $29.3 billion in 2026 to $40.4 billion in 2028—a near‑40% increase over two years—driven by V3 satellite deployments, reduced launch costs from Starship, and the gradual emergence of 6G non‑terrestrial network applications. The beneficiary scope is widening from components to full‑module and system integration.

Within the industry value chain, ground‑device manufacturing accounts for a hefty 54.58% of total output, making it the largest segment and the one where Taiwanese firms hold the strongest competitive edge. As Starlink’s subscriber base climbs to 12 million and Amazon’s Blue Origin plans an orbital data‑center and TeraWave enterprise‑grade satellite communications network backed by more than 50,000 satellites, massive demand for ground terminals is being released at speed.

To deepen its technology and cut RF front‑end costs, Qisda recently partnered with the Institute for Information Industry’s Communications Research Institute to push mass production of a domestically‑made Ka‑band array‑antenna module. The effort leverages Taiwan’s first home‑grown beam‑forming chip to accelerate commercialization of high‑mobility terminals such as ground receivers, drones and vehicle‑mounted units.

Yao‑Den is targeting the 6G non‑terrestrial network and LEO ground‑equipment market. In addition to securing a Ka‑band ground‑station project from the National Space Center and engaging with LEO and medium‑high‑orbit satellite customers, the company has extended its measurement‑certification capabilities to satellite ground‑transceiver equipment, offering customers a one‑stop integrated service.

In its measurement‑equipment business, Yao‑Den has incorporated two key satellite‑communication simulation and antenna‑testing equipment agents from Canada and Denmark. Regarding overseas capacity, both partners are actively advancing non‑red‑supply‑chain layouts to absorb long‑term orders. Qisda is expanding capacity in Vietnam and Mexico, aiming for Vietnam to account for over half of its output by 2026, while Yao‑Den’s new Vietnam plant is slated to start production in Q3, with the line designed for future expansion to up to 18 lines.

items.title: 每2人就有1個E人！貝萊德調查：台灣ETF滲透率53%穩居亞太第一
items.title_en: One in Two People Own an ETF! BlackRock Survey Shows Taiwan’s ETF Penetration at 53%, Highest in Asia‑Pacific
paras: 全球最大ETF品牌貝萊德iShares發布最新《2026亞太ETF投資人洞察》報告，揭露台灣成年人持有ETF的滲透率高達53%，高居亞太五大市場之冠。相較於香港的31%、新加坡的18.7%、澳洲的16%及日本的3%，台灣市場展現極高的普及度與成熟度。在產品偏好上，台灣投資人除了擁抱股票型（55%）與高股息型（52%）外，對「主動型ETF」的偏好度更達40%，顯著超越澳洲與香港，成為亞太區主動型商品需求最旺盛的市場。貝萊德投信表示，ETF在台灣已從單純投資工具轉化為全民理財基礎，未來成長動能將來自配置觀念的持續進化。
當ETF從單純的投資工具演變為全民理財語言，台灣正以驚人的普及速度站上亞太市場的領先地位。全球最大ETF品牌貝萊德iShares最新發布《2026亞太ETF投資人洞察》報告，揭露亞太五大市場的最新投資面貌。調查顯示，台灣成年人持有ETF的滲透率高達53%，不僅榮登亞太五大市場龍頭，普及率更遠超日本的3%近18倍，展現顯著的區域成熟度落差。
針對本次宏觀調查結果，貝萊德投信董事總經理陳正芳表示，這項橫跨台灣、澳洲、日本、新加坡及香港的調查顯示，亞太各地的ETF發展步調存在巨大懸殊。台灣成年人在ETF持有滲透率上拔得頭籌（53%），大幅領先第二名香港的31%、新加坡的18.7%與澳洲的16%，而日本市場則以3%居末，凸顯台灣在ETF市場的普及程度已成熟領跑全亞太。
在產品偏好層面，陳正芳分析，亞太區投資人對ETF展現出「核心配置共通、周邊需求在地化」的分歧特色。雖然股票型與收益型ETF是亞太各市場共同的核心投資基石，但走出核心資產之外，各市場的投資偏好則展現出鮮明的在地色彩。
陳正芳進一步說明，台灣投資人除了高度青睞股票型（55%）與高股息／收益型ETF（52%）外，對「主動型ETF」的偏好更在亞太市場中異軍突起，持有比例高達40%。這一數據顯著超越澳洲的25%與香港的24%，讓台灣一舉成為亞太區主動型商品需求最旺盛的市場。
對比亞太其他地區，各國投資人的偏好呈現多元發展。澳洲投資人高度偏好數位資產（加密貨幣）ETF，比例高達40%，僅次於股票型的58%；香港投資人除了以股票型（75%）為大宗外，偏好則廣泛分散於債券型（47%）、商品型（39%）與貨幣型ETF（37%）。
陳正芳強調，調查結果充分反映台灣在ETF普及率與產品接受度上均已躍居亞太領頭羊，投資人不僅將ETF視為核心資產配置工具，對主動型等新型態ETF也展現出成熟且開放的配置意願。ETF在台灣已從單純的投資工具，逐步發展為大眾理財與長期資產配置的重要基礎，未來市場成長動能將不僅來自投資人數增加，更來自投資需求的持續進化與配置觀念的成熟。
paras_en: BlackRock’s iShares, the world’s largest ETF brand, released its latest “2026 Asia‑Pacific ETF Investor Insights” report, revealing that 53% of Taiwanese adults hold ETFs, the highest penetration among the five major Asia‑Pacific markets. Compared with Hong Kong’s 31%, Singapore’s 18.7%, Australia’s 16% and Japan’s 3%, Taiwan demonstrates a very high level of adoption and market maturity. In terms of product preference, Taiwanese investors not only embrace equity‑type (55%) and high‑dividend (52%) ETFs, but also show a 40% preference for “active ETFs,” markedly surpassing Australia and Hong Kong and making Taiwan the strongest demand market for active products in the region. BlackRock Investment Management says ETFs in Taiwan have shifted from a simple investment tool to a foundation of personal finance for the whole population, with future growth driven by the continued evolution of allocation concepts.

As ETFs evolve from a pure investment tool into a language of personal finance for the masses, Taiwan is rapidly taking the lead in the Asia‑Pacific market. BlackRock’s iShares has just published its “2026 Asia‑Pacific ETF Investor Insights” report, unveiling the latest investment landscape across the five largest markets in the region. The survey shows that 53% of Taiwanese adults hold ETFs, not only topping the Asia‑Pacific list but also exceeding Japan’s 3% by nearly eighteen‑fold, highlighting a striking regional maturity gap.

Commenting on the macro‑survey results, Chen Zheng‑fang, Managing Director of BlackRock Investment Management, said the cross‑country study covering Taiwan, Australia, Japan, Singapore and Hong Kong shows a huge disparity in ETF development across Asia‑Pacific. Taiwanese adults lead with a 53% ETF‑holding penetration, far ahead of second‑place Hong Kong at 31%, Singapore at 18.7% and Australia at 16%, while Japan trails at 3%, underscoring Taiwan’s mature and leading position in the regional ETF market.

On product preference, Chen explained that investors across Asia‑Pacific exhibit a “core allocation commonality with localized peripheral demand.” While equity‑type and income‑type ETFs form the core investment foundation in all markets, preferences beyond these core assets display distinct local characteristics.

Chen added that Taiwanese investors not only strongly favor equity‑type (55%) and high‑dividend/income ETFs (52%), but also stand out in the region for their preference for “active ETFs,” with a holding rate of 40%. This figure far exceeds Australia’s 25% and Hong Kong’s 24%, making Taiwan the market with the most vigorous demand for active products in Asia‑Pacific.

Compared with other Asia‑Pacific regions, investors’ preferences are diverse. Australian investors show a high appetite for digital‑asset (cryptocurrency) ETFs, at 40%, second only to equity‑type ETFs at 58%. Hong Kong investors, besides a dominant 75% preference for equity‑type ETFs, spread their interest across bond ETFs (47%), commodity ETFs (39%) and currency ETFs (37%).

Chen emphasized that the survey results clearly show Taiwan has become the Asia‑Pacific leader in both ETF penetration and product acceptance. Investors view ETFs not only as core asset‑allocation tools but also demonstrate a mature and open willingness to allocate to newer formats such as active ETFs. In Taiwan, ETFs have progressed from a simple investment instrument to a fundamental component of mass‑market financial planning and long‑term asset allocation, with future market growth driven not only by a larger investor base but also by the ongoing evolution of investment demand and sophisticated allocation mindsets.

items.title: 嘉威9月營收再現年成長達44% 前9月營收下滑幅度進一步收歛
items.title_en: Jiawei September Revenue Shows 44% Year‑over‑Year Growth as Nine‑Month Decline Further Narrows
paras: 嘉威生活(3557-TW)迎接旺季來臨前的需求再進一步升溫，嘉威9月營收達2.98億元，月增14.02%，年增44.56%；累計2026年前9月營收31.65億元，年減幅由前8月的8.85%進一步收斂至5.57%，營運回升趨勢更加明確；同時，嘉威生活第四季將迎接歐美的採購需求超級旺季。
嘉威生活的累計營收下滑幅度收歛，主要在第三季營收達7.7億元，年增幅21.18%；回升趨勢明確。 展望第四季，嘉威生活隨著美國零售市場正式進入Holiday傳統消費旺季，各主要客戶的節慶商品及Everyday商品持續出貨，公司預期第四季拉貨動能可望延續。
而嘉威生活前三季累計營收年減幅已由前8月的8.85%快速收斂至5.57%，加上FDG及Prepara持續貢獻，嘉威預期第四季可望進一步縮小與去年同期的累計營收差距，持續改善全年營運表現。
嘉威主管指出，雖然9月美國客戶已提前啟動第四季旺季拉貨模式，各主要零售通路的Holiday節慶商品全面進入出貨期，加上長期穩定的Everyday常態性商品訂單，兩大產品線合計已占公司約一半出貨量，成為9月營收大幅成長的重要動能，也反映美國市場拉貨力道持續升溫。
除大型零售通路外，嘉威長期深耕Pottery Barn、Crate & Barrel及Williams-Sonoma等中高階居家生活客戶，相關高附加價值產品維持穩定出貨，持續支持嘉威的獲利品質，形成大型零售客戶帶動營收規模、中高階客戶兼顧獲利的多元客戶組合。
海外布局方面，嘉威美國子公司FDG 9月持續貢獻營收，出貨櫃量占中國整體出貨櫃量逾10%；旗下廚具品牌Prepara則持續開發新品，加速全球銷售及通路布局，目前產品已銷往美國、歐洲、日本及韓國。公司並在美國及歐洲當地設立倉庫，透過就近供應優勢提升出貨效率，顯示除嘉威本體外，美國子公司及品牌業務也逐步挹注集團營運表現。
嘉威生活2026年上半年營收 23.95 億元，年減 11.8%，主要受到第一季營收下滑影響，不過，隨著第二季營運逐步回升，上半年毛利率仍達 35.52%，較去年同期提升 0.27 百分點；稅後純益 5704 萬元，每股純益 0.68 元。
paras_en: Jiawei Living (3557‑TW) saw demand heat up ahead of the peak season, with September revenue reaching NT$298 million, up 14.02% month‑over‑month and 44.56% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first nine months of 2026 was NT$3.165 billion, with the year‑over‑year decline narrowing from an 8.85% drop in the first eight months to 5.57%, indicating a clearer operational recovery. The company also expects a super‑strong procurement season in Europe and the United States in Q4.

The contraction in cumulative revenue was driven by a strong third‑quarter performance of NT$770 million, a 21.18% year‑over‑year increase, underscoring the rebound trend. Looking ahead to Q4, Jiawei Living anticipates continued momentum as the U.S. retail market enters the traditional holiday shopping season, with major customers shipping festive and everyday items, which should sustain the pull‑forward effect.

The year‑over‑year decline in cumulative revenue for the first three quarters has quickly narrowed from 8.85% after eight months to 5.57% after nine months. Combined with ongoing contributions from FDG and the Prepara brand, Jiawei expects the gap with the same period last year to shrink further in Q4, further improving full‑year performance.

Management noted that, although U.S. customers began pulling forward fourth‑quarter inventory in September, holiday merchandise across major retail channels entered the shipping phase, and stable everyday product orders persisted. The two product lines now account for roughly half of the company's shipments, driving the strong September revenue growth and reflecting continued acceleration of pull‑forward activity in the U.S. market.

Beyond large retail chains, Jiawei has long cultivated mid‑to‑high‑end home‑lifestyle customers such as Pottery Barn, Crate & Barrel and Williams‑Sonoma. High‑margin products for these accounts remain steady, supporting profit quality and creating a diversified customer mix that balances scale from big retailers with profitability from premium clients.

On the overseas front, Jiawei’s U.S. subsidiary FDG continued to contribute in September, with its container shipments representing more than 10% of the group's total containers shipped from China. Its kitchenware brand Prepara kept launching new products, accelerating global sales and channel expansion, with offerings now in the United States, Europe, Japan and South Korea. The company has also set up warehouses in the U.S. and Europe to improve delivery efficiency, showing that the U.S. subsidiary and brand businesses are increasingly bolstering the group’s overall performance.

Jiawei Living posted first‑half‑2026 revenue of NT$2.395 billion, an 11.8% year‑over‑year decline, mainly due to weaker first‑quarter sales. However, as operations recovered in the second quarter, the half‑year gross margin remained at 35.52%, up 0.27 percentage points from a year earlier. Net profit after tax was NT$57.04 million, or NT$0.68 per share.

paras: 伸興(1558-TW)公告2026年9月合併營收達 9.68 億元，月增8.81%，年增29.19%，創今年單月營收新高；2026年第三季合併營收達27.95億元，季增21.95%，年增24.31%；累計前9月合併營收70.13億元，年增8.35%。受惠於主要客戶拉貨動能增溫與產業旺季效益，良好的訂單成長基礎，有助於今年整體營運保持良好的正向成長動能。
伸興表示，每年第二至第三季是家用縫紉機產業的傳統出貨旺季，主要受惠於歐美市場聖誕節、感恩節等節慶購物季前夕的通路補貨需求。隨著終端零售通路庫存健康度持續回升，各大國際縫紉機品牌客戶積極備貨，推升公司9月家用縫紉機出貨量大幅提升。
除傳統季節性旺季效益發酵外，近年來全球手作DIY文化、客製化服飾與個人化手作紡織品的流行趨勢熱度不減，進一步帶動中高階家用縫紉機與多功能電縫機的穩定需求。伸興憑藉優異的研發製造能力，成功協助客戶推出具備智慧化與便利操作功能的機種，有效掌握市場趨勢，進一步挹注整體營運成長動能，助力整體訂單保持良好的能見度。
面對全球供應鏈重組與市場快速變化的挑戰，伸興持續精進台灣、中國、東南亞地區的產能佈局與精實生產，並發揮靈活調度優勢，不僅有效維持優異的生產效率與產品良率，亦能迅速響應品牌客戶的急單與彈性拉貨需求，發揮強大的供應鏈管理韌性。
展望2026年第四季，伸興對整體營運發展保持審慎態度。隨著第四季持續迎來傳統多元產業需求，加上縫紉機在中高階機種出貨比重提升與全球產能彈性調度的優勢，公司有信心推升下半年營運效益，帶動2026全年整體營運規模與績效繳出良好的成績單。
paras_en: Shenxing (1558‑TW) announced that its consolidated revenue for September 2026 reached NT$968 million, up 8.81% month‑over‑month and 29.19% year‑over‑year, marking the highest monthly revenue this year; the third‑quarter consolidated revenue was NT$2.795 billion, up 21.95% quarter‑over‑quarter and 24.31% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first nine months totaled NT$7.013 billion, an 8.35% increase year‑over‑year. Benefiting from stronger pull‑forward orders from major customers and seasonal industry effects, the solid order‑growth foundation helps maintain a positive growth momentum for the year’s overall operations.

Shenxing noted that the second to third quarters are the traditional shipping peak season for the household sewing‑machine industry, mainly driven by replenishment demand ahead of holiday shopping seasons such as Christmas and Thanksgiving in Europe and the United States. As inventory health in end‑retail channels continues to improve, major international sewing‑machine brands are actively stocking up, boosting the company’s household sewing‑machine shipments sharply in September.

Beyond the usual seasonal boost, the recent global DIY craft culture, customized apparel, and personalized textile trends have kept demand for mid‑to‑high‑end household sewing machines and multifunctional electric sewing machines strong. Leveraging its superior R&D and manufacturing capabilities, Shenxing has helped customers launch models with smart and user‑friendly features, effectively capturing market trends and injecting further growth momentum into overall operations, supporting a healthy order outlook.

Facing the challenges of global supply‑chain restructuring and rapid market changes, Shenxing continues to refine its capacity layout and lean production in Taiwan, China and Southeast Asia, and to exploit flexible scheduling advantages. This not only sustains high production efficiency and product yield, but also enables rapid response to urgent orders and flexible pull‑forward requests from brand customers, demonstrating strong supply‑chain resilience.

Looking ahead to the fourth quarter of 2026, Shenxing maintains a cautious stance on overall operational development. With the quarter expected to bring continued diversified industry demand, an increasing share of mid‑to‑high‑end sewing‑machine shipments, and the advantage of flexible global capacity scheduling, the company is confident it can lift second‑half performance and deliver a solid full‑year operational scale and results.
